parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query with paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: The department name. Matches any level of department in the organizational structure to which the user belongs. Specify the department name itself without the full path of the organizational structure.

parameters.name: DevTag
parameters.description:
The unique identifier of the user endpoint device. Exact match. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values are obtained from:
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): lists user endpoint devices.

parameters.name: DevType
parameters.description:
The operating system type of the user endpoint device. Valid values:
- **windows**: Windows. Currently, vulnerability scanning supports only Windows.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: The hostname of the user endpoint device. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Settings for paged query with paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: SaseUserId
parameters.description:
The user ID. Exact match. Valid values are obtained from:
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): lists user endpoint devices.
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): queries the details of a user endpoint device.

parameters.name: ScanTaskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the vulnerability scanning node that detected the vulnerability. Used to filter detection results of a specified node. Valid values are obtained from:
- [ListVulScanTasks](~~ListVulScanTasks~~): lists vulnerability scanning nodes.
- [CreateVulScanTask](~~CreateVulScanTask~~): creates a vulnerability scanning node.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The vulnerability title. Fuzzy match is supported. Matches both Chinese and English titles.

parameters.name: UpdateIds
parameters.description: The patch IDs used for filtering. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username. Fuzzy match is supported. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), asterisks (*), hyphens (-), at signs (@), spaces, middle dots (·), and parentheses.

parameters.name: VulLevel
parameters.description:
The vulnerability risk level used for filtering. Valid values:
- **High**: high risk.
- **Mid**: medium risk.
- **Low**: low risk.

parameters.name: VulType
parameters.description:
The vulnerability type used for filtering. Valid values:
- **windows**: Windows system vulnerability.
- **ai_agent**: AI Agent vulnerability.
